applicableDomain: Emergency Department Resuscitation & Unstable Patient Escalation
descriptionAndPurpose: High-priority clinical escalation workflow activated when triage detects an unstable patient (ESI 1-2 or red-flag vital signs), supporting provisional emergency MPI identities, mandatory EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypassing financial gates, STAT ancillary routing, and audited post-stabilization financial reconciliation.
requiredInputData: patientId (verified or provisional emergency MPI identity)
prerequisiteConditions: Triage nurse or clinician triggers emergency acuity escalation.
Provisional emergency identity allowed when patient is unconscious or unidentified; audited MPI merge occurs once identity is confirmed.
safetyChecks: Routine prepayment and insurance prior-authorization rules are NEVER permitted to block stabilization or STAT orders.
Emergency override reason and authorizing actor are recorded in immutable @ClinicalAudit trail.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi MUST return EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE with fulfillmentEligible=true and routeToCashierWorklist=false.
Deferred financial reconciliation occurs only after clinical stabilization.
exceptionRoutes: PROVISIONAL_MPI_MERGE_WORKFLOW once next-of-kin or ID documents arrive
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Emergency escalations cannot be silently cancelled; downgrade to routine care requires explicit attending clinician attestation.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: Mandatory @ClinicalAudit logging of every EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE event, provisional identity creation, and subsequent MPI merge/reassociation.
completionCriteria: Patient stabilized and transitioned to inpatient admission, operating theatre, safe discharge, or documented transfer.
